title: Big bands passing through Washington
summary: Fletcher Henderson, Chick Webb, Zack White, Jess Williams and Small's Paradise bands all came to Washington.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Who else would come through Washington while you were there?

All the bands, Fletcher Henderson would come through there, Chick Webb, some bands from Middle West would come through and play, Zack White, and he had a popular band back in those days, and there was an old guy out of New York, Jess Williams, he had a band.
He's very funny, had a big, high hat and big coat with jewels on it. I don't know; he had all kind of funny things. He dressed real star spangled, what I used to call it.

And they all would come through Washington. Washington was one, you know, wasn't far from New York, and lot of the top groups would come through there. There's another band from around New York, the band from Charlie
Small's, from Small's Paradise. Those bands used to come through.

But the -- the big name bands at that time were Fletcher, Duke, Chick Webb. They were the big bands that came out of New York, and they would come to Washington quite -- quite frequently. This is -- this goes back, you know, '28-29. That's a long time ago, you know.
